4️⃣ A banner will appear at the top of the page in a black box saying "$200 in extra usage, on us"

(The amount varies depending on your plan)

5️⃣ Click the white "Claim your credit" button inside it

6️⃣ When the pop-up appears, turn on the Extra usage feature (Toggle ON)

7️⃣ Done! Immediately check your Current Balance to see if the amount has been credited.

🚨🚨 Most Important Notice 🚨🚨

Once you have used up all your credit, the "Extra usage" feature remains turned on.

If you exceed your monthly subscription limit while this is enabled, money will be automatically deducted from your card.

👉 As soon as you use up all your credit, go to Settings → Usage → Toggle "Extra usage" off!

(Alternatively, setting your Monthly spend limit to $1 is also an option.)
